title: 20th Century Boys
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In 1969 a group of boys write a 'Book of Prophecy' about villains destroying the world. Decades later, convenience-store owner Kenji discovers a cult led by the masked 'Friend' is carrying out their childhood story, and he and his old friends try to stop a plot of bombings and viral attacks, then resist Friend's later rule.
life_message: It holds up childhood friendship, courage and music as forces that can stand against mass manipulation.

content.note: Bombings, viral attacks and mass death in the plot (Wikipedia; to verify on-page detail).
Apocalyptic conspiracy and dread (Wikipedia; AniList Conspiracy 90%, Tragedy).
